name: subject-library
purpose: A library of learning subjects in a divider grid: each subject is one framed card with its name, what it covers and a list of its article links, and an optional closing call to action spans the grid's last two cells so the grid ends without an empty cell. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'subject-library', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — so its whole API is the props below, and it composes `section-module`, `frame-box`, `card-grid`, `call-to-action` and `button` rather than owning any anatomy of its own.
useWhen: On the Learning Center index, to list every subject with the articles that teach it.
Whenever a page needs a grid of topic cards that each carry a short list of links, closed by one call to action.
avoidWhen: For a grid of features with artwork → use `feature-tiles`.
For a filterable list of rows → use `listing-browser`.
Inside another band's cell → compose `frame-box` and `call-to-action` directly.
related: call-to-action` — the `lead` band drawn in the closing cell.
card-grid` — the divider grid the subject cards sit in.
bestPractices: Give every subject a unique `slug`; it is the card's `id`, so a `#slug` link lands on it.
Keep the subject count at a multiple of three plus one when `closing` is set, so the closing cell fills the last row exactly.
Keep each subject's articles to a handful; the card grows with its list.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page `id` of the band, the target of a `#hash` link.

props.name: subjects
props.doc: The subject cards, in order; each is `{ slug, title, description, articles }` where every article is `{ label, href }`. Subjects without a title or a linked article are skipped.

props.name: closing
props.doc: Call to action across the grid's last two cells; `{ eyebrow, title, titleMuted, description, primaryAction, secondaryAction }` where each action is `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import SubjectLibrary from '@aziontech/webkit/subject-library'
</script>

<template>
  <SubjectLibrary
    anchor="subjects"
    :subjects="[
      {
        slug: 'bots',
        title: 'Bots',
        description:
          'Bots are automated software programs that perform repetitive tasks on websites and applications.',
        articles: [
          {
            label: 'What is a Bot?',
            href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/learning/bots/what-is-a-bot/'
          },
          {
            label: 'What is Bot Management?',
            href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/learning/bots/what-is-bot-management/'
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        slug: 'cdn',
        title: 'CDN',
        description: 'Reduce latency by caching static content on servers close to the user.',
        articles: [
          { label: 'What is a CDN?', href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/learning/cdn/what-is-a-cdn/' },
          {
            label: 'What is Caching?',
            href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/learning/cdn/what-is-caching/'
          }
        ]
      }
    ]"
    :closing="{
      eyebrow: 'Next step',
      title: 'Put what you learned to work.',
      titleMuted: 'On Azion.',
      description:
        'Deploy your first application in minutes, or talk to an expert about your architecture.',
      primaryAction: { label: 'Start for free', href: '/signup' },
      secondaryAction: { label: 'Talk to a specialist', href: '/contact', trailing: true }
    }"
  />
</template>
